name: apex-best-20261115-v2
role: pinned rollback baseline for Goose optimisation work
why: The next optimisation stage must start here, not from a rebuild that silently loses what was measured. Every field below is what produced the recorded numbers; nothing is inferred.

libraries.note: libggml-cpu.so.0 AND libggml-cpu-shared-dd5a40e47065.so.0.27.0 must both be this hash - the loader takes one by SONAME and the other as a ggml plugin by path. Fixing only one left 176 tok/s on the table. run-apex.sh refuses to start if either differs.
libraries.libggml-base: libggml-base-scheduler-bafe3955c9ea (sha e213fa19...) - the build that defines fg160_fusion_enabled and fg160_query; the plain libggml-base.so.0 build defines neither
libraries.libllama: abfe9400488e (stage-run, 327 fg bindings). NOT libllama-exp244 (2bc628a1, 214 bindings): it fails with cudaMalloc OOM at 1124 MiB against this ggml, an ABI mismatch, not memory pressure.

environment.note: 18 GGML_GOOSE_* values plus GGML_EXPERT_HOTSTORE=0, applied verbatim by run-apex.sh from that file
environment.ggml_backend_path: must NOT be set - it was measured at prefill 2006.50 versus 2222.38, and registering the same CPU backend twice appears to initialise it twice

at_128_tokens.note: measured at cache 4608 before the sweep; not re-measured at 4352

measured.content_sha256_note: identical to the 2026-11-13 reference; the same answer, not a similar one

reference_for_comparison.rule: compare only at the same generation length; the reference itself gives 39.6 at 128 and 41.94 at 512, and mixing them made a 95% result look like 82%

3584.role: economical - 768 MiB cheaper for 17.9% less decode

4480.note: loses to 4352 on prefill and VRAM, decode within noise

4608.note: a local dip - this is why 'more cache is better' was wrong

limits.oom_evidence: 5120 failed twice, the second time with 8568 MiB showing free - the allocation is contiguous and the device cannot provide it

rollback: bash runtime/goose-stage/run-apex.sh --cache 4352. The script verifies both CPU hashes and a free port before starting, so a wrong library or a busy port is refused rather than silently measured. Libraries are symlinks into the stage-run tree; nothing in that tree is modified.
updates: Revised after the ubatch and cache sweep. Two configurations are now named: the reference profile for long prompts, and a long-generation profile that reaches 42.35 decode - above the 41.94 historical reference - at the cost of 16.9% prefill.

long_generation.name: best-balance
long_generation.note: ubatch 2048; cache 5376 is a THRESHOLD not a limit - 5504 runs 1.9 tok/s slower and 5632 fails intermittently

thresholds.cache_5376: maximum safe; 5504 is 1.9 tok/s SLOWER (residency cliff), 5632 intermittent OOM
thresholds.ubatch_2048: optimal; 1536 and 1024 both cost prefill with no decode gain over 2048+cache

history: superseded first entry: cache 4352 alone gave 39.86; see configurations above
